ABC Monday Evening Ride

Munroe Falls, OH · Road · Mixed

No-dropBeginner friendly

ABC Monday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Munroe Falls, OH. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Brust Park. About 16 miles, 11–13 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the ABC Monday Evening Ride group ride

A social ride at a comfortable pace for beginning and casual riders, mixing road and paved trail. Routes vary weekly. Regroups often and no one is left behind. Helmets required.
